name: @jskit-ai/resource-runtime
description: The resource runtime: features own their tables through it and read and write them with scoped handles on json-rest-api.

surfaces.summary: Provides runtime.resources: own(featureId, owns) registers a feature's tables and answers their handles; createSystemContext gives background work its context. Exports the runtime's error classes.
The json-rest-api host behind the runtime, and the host helpers crud-core, users-core and workspaces-core use until they own their tables through runtime.resources.
Types of runtime.resources, its handles, call options and system contexts.
Data test helpers on a real test database: expectScoped, expectFlatQueries, expectEveryTableOwned and requireTestDatabase.
